text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm Machikane Tannhauser,
it's nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'd love to run in an amazing race that would make everyone happy~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna do my best in training!
Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
